regime_detail: bootstrap tables only; no names, no model
split_field: dev.json: CausalArena dev replays (exact references, pooled) plus live dev runs (contested references, agreement only); heldout_H1/H2/H3.json: the batteries of plans/r3_prereg.json; regress_q011.json: one pair, a regression check

controls.columns_shuffled: per-group (formula replays permuted per file; semantic replays in released order; live as recorded)
controls.names_detail: variable labels are not read by the numeric bootstrap direction rule
controls.supplier_field: CausalArena replay data or recorded live-run input, as identified by the dev.json groups; no knowledge supplier is used

orientation_rule: committed arrows only: an open direction is no prediction (cc_graph.score convention); right / wrong / open / partial counted on true links found, arrows on false links counted apart

metric_defs.right: true link found, arrow as in the reference
metric_defs.arrows_on_false_links: arrows on linked pairs the reference does not link
